case_title: BANK OF THE WEST VS. NASEF KHALIL et al

docket_entries.description: ABSTRACT OF JUDGMENT ISSUED TO PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF MAY-04-2007 IS OFF CALENDAR. JUDGMENT ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KHALIL, NASEF INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA ECO CLEANERS POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $24,699.30 DAMAGES, $2,800.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $344.00 COSTS, $880.10 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $28,723.40, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
